```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")

# Upstream requirements:
#   01_data_import_cleaning.Rmd -> Chik_total (confirmed CHIK only, 2016-2025)
#   02_population_panel.R       -> pop_panel_total (municipality x year population)
#
# Revised scope: chikungunya only, 1 Jan 2016 through 31 Dec 2025.
STUDY_START_YEAR <- 2016L
STUDY_END_YEAR   <- 2025L
STUDY_START_DATE <- as.Date("2016-01-01")
STUDY_END_DATE   <- as.Date("2025-12-31")
STUDY_LABEL      <- "2016-2025"

stopifnot(
  exists("Chik_total"),
  exists("pop_panel_total"),
  all(Chik_total$CLASSI_FIN %in% c(1, 13)),
  all(as.Date(Chik_total$DT_SIN_PRI) >= STUDY_START_DATE),
  all(as.Date(Chik_total$DT_SIN_PRI) <= STUDY_END_DATE)
)

# All rows in Chik_total are confirmed chikungunya notifications by construction.
# Do NOT use case_status == "Confirmed" as the case denominator because deaths
# are labelled case_status == "Death" in file 01 and would be incorrectly lost.
chik <- Chik_total %>%
  mutate(
    DT_SIN_PRI = as.Date(DT_SIN_PRI),
    year_int   = lubridate::year(DT_SIN_PRI),
    year       = as.character(year_int),
    month_date = lubridate::floor_date(DT_SIN_PRI, unit = "month"),
    is_death   = EVOLUCAO == 2,
    is_hosp    = as.character(HOSPITALIZ) == "1"
  )
```

## Population denominators

```{r nat-pop-by-year}
nat_pop_by_year <- pop_panel_total %>%
  filter(year >= STUDY_START_YEAR, year <= STUDY_END_YEAR) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(nat_pop = sum(total_pop, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(year = as.character(year))

stopifnot(
  nrow(nat_pop_by_year) == length(STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR),
  all(nat_pop_by_year$nat_pop > 0)
)
```

Case-severity codes follow the SINAN Dengue/Chikungunya data dictionary:
1 = cure, 2 = death due to chikungunya, 3 = death due to other causes,
4 = death under investigation, and 9 = unknown.

## Core annual descriptive summary

```{r annual-summary}
annual_summary <- chik %>%
  group_by(year_int) %>%
  summarise(
    confirmed_cases = n(),
    deaths = sum(is_death, na.rm = TRUE),
    hospitalized = sum(is_hosp, na.rm = TRUE),
    hosp_status_known = sum(as.character(HOSPITALIZ) %in% c("1", "2")),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CFR_percent = 100 * deaths / confirmed_cases,
    hospitalization_percent = 100 * hospitalized / hosp_status_known
  )

print(annual_summary)
```

## Deaths by symptom-onset year and month

These plots index fatal cases by symptom-onset date (`DT_SIN_PRI`), not by the
calendar date of death. This keeps the denominator aligned with the main
surveillance time axis used elsewhere in the paper.

```{r deaths-by-year}
chik_death_yearly <- chik %>%
  filter(is_death) %>%
  count(year_int, name = "deaths") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    year_int = STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR,
    fill = list(deaths = 0L)
  )

ggplot(chik_death_yearly, aes(x = factor(year_int), y = deaths)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E76F51") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Chikungunya deaths by symptom-onset year, Brazil, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Year", y = "Number of deaths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r deaths-by-month}
chik_death_monthly <- chik %>%
  filter(is_death) %>%
  mutate(
    month = factor(
      format(DT_SIN_PRI, "%m"),
      levels = sprintf("%02d", 1:12),
      labels = month.abb,
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  count(year_int, month, name = "deaths") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    year_int = STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR,
    month = factor(month.abb, levels = month.abb, ordered = TRUE),
    fill = list(deaths = 0L)
  )

ggplot(chik_death_monthly, aes(x = month, y = deaths)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E76F51") +
  facet_wrap(~ year_int, ncol = 5) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Monthly chikungunya deaths by symptom-onset year, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Month", y = "Number of deaths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

## Age distribution: confirmed cases and deaths

```{r age-distribution}
chik_age_valid <- chik %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_years), age_years >= 0, age_years <= 120)

ggplot(chik_age_valid, aes(x = age_years)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, boundary = 0, fill = "#457B9D", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Age distribution of confirmed chikungunya cases, Brazil, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Age (years)", y = "Number of confirmed cases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplot(chik_age_valid %>% filter(is_death), aes(x = age_years)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, boundary = 0, fill = "#E76F51", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Age distribution of chikungunya deaths, Brazil, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Age (years)", y = "Number of deaths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r age-group-composition}
confirmed_age_pct <- chik %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  count(age_group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n))

death_age_pct <- chik %>%
  filter(is_death, !is.na(age_group)) %>%
  count(age_group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n))

ggplot(confirmed_age_pct, aes(x = age_group, y = percentage)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#457B9D") +
  labs(
    title = "Age-group composition of confirmed chikungunya cases",
    x = "Age group", y = "Percentage of confirmed cases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplot(death_age_pct, aes(x = age_group, y = percentage)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E76F51") +
  labs(
    title = "Age-group composition of chikungunya deaths",
    x = "Age group", y = "Percentage of deaths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Case fatality by age group

This is retained as a descriptive case-based measure only. It is not the
revision's primary geographic severity surface, because case fatality is
conditioned on notification and is sensitive to ascertainment and access to
care. The population-denominator severity analysis is handled downstream.

```{r cfr-by-age}
cfr_by_age <- chik %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    confirmed = n(),
    deaths = sum(is_death, na.rm = TRUE),
    CFR_percent = 100 * deaths / confirmed,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(cfr_by_age)

ggplot(cfr_by_age, aes(x = age_group, y = CFR_percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E76F51") +
  labs(
    title = "Case fatality among confirmed chikungunya cases by age group",
    x = "Age group", y = "Case fatality (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Annual age composition

```{r age-composition-per-year}
age_year_summary <- chik %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
  count(year_int, age_group, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(year_int) %>%
  mutate(percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(age_year_summary, aes(x = factor(year_int), y = percentage, fill = age_group)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Age-group composition of confirmed chikungunya cases, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Year", y = "Percentage of confirmed cases", fill = "Age group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Hospitalization among confirmed cases

```{r hospitalization-rate}
chik_hosp_summary <- chik %>%
  filter(as.character(HOSPITALIZ) %in% c("1", "2")) %>%
  count(HOSPITALIZ = as.character(HOSPITALIZ), name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    hosp_status = if_else(HOSPITALIZ == "1", "Hospitalized", "Not hospitalized"),
    percentage = 100 * n / sum(n)
  )

print(chik_hosp_summary)

ggplot(chik_hosp_summary, aes(x = hosp_status, y = percentage, fill = hosp_status)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Hospitalization status among confirmed chikungunya cases",
    x = NULL, y = "Percentage of cases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Delay distributions

```{r delay-model}
chik_delay <- chik %>%
  mutate(
    report_delay = as.numeric(as.Date(DT_NOTIFIC) - DT_SIN_PRI),
    death_delay  = as.numeric(as.Date(DT_OBITO) - DT_SIN_PRI),
    hosp_delay   = as.numeric(as.Date(DT_INTERNA) - DT_SIN_PRI)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    report_delay = if_else(report_delay >= 0, report_delay, NA_real_),
    death_delay  = if_else(death_delay >= 0, death_delay, NA_real_),
    hosp_delay   = if_else(hosp_delay >= 0, hosp_delay, NA_real_)
  )

ggplot(chik_delay %>% filter(!is.na(report_delay), report_delay < 50),
       aes(x = report_delay)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = "#457B9D", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Delay from symptom onset to notification",
    x = "Delay (days)", y = "Number of confirmed cases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplot(chik_delay %>% filter(is_death, !is.na(death_delay), death_delay < 50),
       aes(x = death_delay)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = "#E76F51", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Delay from symptom onset to death",
    x = "Delay (days)", y = "Number of deaths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplot(chik_delay %>% filter(is_hosp, !is.na(hosp_delay), hosp_delay < 50),
       aes(x = hosp_delay)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = "#2A9D8F", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Delay from symptom onset to hospitalization",
    x = "Delay (days)", y = "Number of hospitalized cases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

The formal Kaplan-Meier and Cox analyses are in `08_survival_cox.Rmd`; they are
not duplicated here.

## Annual age distribution box plots

```{r age-boxplots}
chik_age_year <- chik %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_years), age_years >= 0, age_years <= 120) %>%
  mutate(year_f = factor(year_int, levels = STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR))

ggplot(chik_age_year, aes(x = year_f, y = age_years)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#457B9D", outlier.size = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.4) +

  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplot(
  chik_age_year %>% filter(CS_SEXO %in% c("M", "F")),
  aes(x = year_f, y = age_years, fill = CS_SEXO)
) +
```

## National incidence and mortality per 100,000

```{r mortality-incidence}
inc_year_nat <- chik %>%
  count(year, name = "cases") %>%
  left_join(nat_pop_by_year, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(incidence_per_100k = 1e5 * cases / nat_pop)

stopifnot(!anyNA(inc_year_nat$nat_pop))

ggplot(inc_year_nat, aes(x = year, y = incidence_per_100k, group = 1)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#457B9D") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Confirmed chikungunya incidence by year, Brazil, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Year", y = "Reported incidence per 100,000"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

deaths_year <- chik %>%
  filter(is_death) %>%
  count(year, name = "deaths") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    year = as.character(STUDY_START_YEAR:STUDY_END_YEAR),
    fill = list(deaths = 0L)
  ) %>%
  left_join(nat_pop_by_year, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(mortality_per_100k = 1e5 * deaths / nat_pop)

stopifnot(!anyNA(deaths_year$nat_pop))

ggplot(deaths_year, aes(x = year, y = mortality_per_100k, group = 1)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#E76F51") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Chikungunya mortality by symptom-onset year, Brazil, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Year", y = "Deaths per 100,000"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Weekly national incidence

```{r weekly-incidence-national}
date_min <- STUDY_START_DATE
date_max <- STUDY_END_DATE

wk_chik <- chik %>%
  mutate(
    week = floor_date(DT_SIN_PRI, "week", week_start = 1),
    year = as.character(year(week))
  ) %>%
  filter(week >= date_min, week <= date_max) %>%
  count(week, year, name = "cases_nat") %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    week = seq(floor_date(date_min, "week", week_start = 1),
               floor_date(date_max, "week", week_start = 1),
               by = "1 week"),
    fill = list(cases_nat = 0L)
  ) %>%
  mutate(year = as.character(year(week))) %>%
  left_join(nat_pop_by_year, by = "year") %>%
  filter(!is.na(nat_pop)) %>%
  mutate(inc_nat_100k = 1e5 * cases_nat / nat_pop) %>%
  arrange(week)

ggplot(wk_chik, aes(x = week, y = inc_nat_100k)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "#E76F51") +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = seq(as.Date("2016-01-01"), as.Date("2025-01-01"), by = "1 year"),
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Weekly reported chikungunya incidence, Brazil, ", STUDY_LABEL),
    x = "Week", y = "Reported incidence per 100,000"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

wk_chik %>% slice_max(inc_nat_100k, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE)
```

## Figure 1A candidate: weekly cases, incidence, and seasonal deviation

```{r figure1-panel-a}
wk_chik <- wk_chik %>%
  select(-any_of(c("week_of_year", "mean_inc", "deviation"))) %>%
  mutate(week_of_year = isoweek(week))

baseline <- wk_chik %>%
  group_by(week_of_year) %>%
  summarise(mean_inc = mean(inc_nat_100k, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

wk_chik <- wk_chik %>%
  left_join(baseline, by = "week_of_year") %>%
  mutate(deviation = inc_nat_100k - mean_inc)

coral      <- "#E76F51"
coral_dark <- "#C24A2C"
teal       <- "#1F7A8C"
dark_text  <- "#1F2933"
grid_line  <- "#ECECEF"
axis_line  <- "#C7CCD3"
neutral_gr <- "#C9CCD1"

cases_max <- ceiling(max(wk_chik$cases_nat, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000) * 1000
incidence_max <- ceiling(max(wk_chik$inc_nat_100k, na.rm = TRUE))
scale_A <- cases_max / incidence_max

# Broad epidemic windows used only as visual annotations.
epi_bands <- data.frame(
  start = as.Date(c("2017-02-01", "2024-02-01")),
  end   = as.Date(c("2017-07-31", "2024-07-31")),
  label = c("2017 epidemic", "2024 epidemic"),
  label_y = c(cases_max * 0.78, cases_max * 0.92)
)

theme_chik <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) %+replace%
    theme(
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = grid_line, linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.line.x        = element_line(color = axis_line, linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line.y        = element_line(color = axis_line, linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks         = element_blank(),
      axis.title         = element_text(color = dark_text),
      axis.text          = element_text(color = dark_text)
    )
}

panel_A_main <- ggplot(wk_chik, aes(x = week)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = epi_bands,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = coral, alpha = 0.06
  ) +
  geom_col(aes(y = cases_nat), fill = neutral_gr, width = 6, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_line(aes(y = inc_nat_100k * scale_A), color = coral, linewidth = 0.85) +
  geom_text(
    data = epi_bands,
    aes(x = start + 20, y = label_y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, color = coral_dark, size = 3, hjust = 0
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = seq(as.Date("2016-01-01"), as.Date("2025-01-01"), by = "1 year"),
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Weekly cases (national total)",
    labels = comma,
    limits = c(0, cases_max),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_A, name = "Weekly incidence (per 100,000)")
  ) +
  labs(title = "A", x = NULL) +
  theme_chik() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = coral_dark),
    axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = coral_dark),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 0, 5)
  )

panel_A_dev <- ggplot(wk_chik, aes(x = week)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = epi_bands,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = coral, alpha = 0.06
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmin(deviation, 0), ymax = 0), fill = teal, alpha = 0.50) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = pmax(deviation, 0)), fill = coral, alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_line(aes(y = deviation), color = dark_text, linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = dark_text, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = seq(as.Date("2016-01-01"), as.Date("2025-01-01"), by = "1 year"),
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Deviation\n(per 100k)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_chik() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 9.5, lineheight = 0.9),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 5, 5, 5)
  )

panel_A <- panel_A_main / panel_A_dev + plot_layout(heights = c(3.6, 1))
print(panel_A)
```



# ============================================================
# Figure 1B: age-window composition of confirmed cases vs deaths
# ============================================================
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Figure 1B: age-window composition of all confirmed cases vs deaths
# ============================================================

case_age_window <- chik %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_years)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_window = case_when(
      age_years < 18 ~ "<18",
      age_years < 60 ~ "18–59",
      TRUE ~ "≥60"
    ),
    age_window = factor(
      age_window,
      levels = c("<18", "18–59", "≥60")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(age_window, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * n / sum(n),
    outcome = "All confirmed cases"
  )

death_age_window <- chik %>%
  filter(is_death == TRUE, !is.na(age_years)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_window = case_when(
      age_years < 18 ~ "<18",
      age_years < 60 ~ "18–59",
      TRUE ~ "≥60"
    ),
    age_window = factor(
      age_window,
      levels = c("<18", "18–59", "≥60")
    )
  ) %>%
  count(age_window, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    percent = 100 * n / sum(n),
    outcome = "Deaths"
  )

age_window_plot <- bind_rows(
  case_age_window,
  death_age_window
)

panel_B <- ggplot(
  age_window_plot,
  aes(x = age_window, y = percent, fill = outcome)
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    width = 0.64
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
    vjust = -0.35,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "All confirmed cases" = neutral_gr,
      "Deaths" = coral
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Percentage within outcome",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "B",
    x = "Age group",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_chik() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

print(panel_B)


figure1 <- wrap_plots(
  panel_A,
  panel_B,
  nrow = 1,
  widths = c(3.5, 1)
)

figure1
```

## Key descriptive checks for manuscript updating

```{r manuscript-checks}
# Age concentration among all confirmed cases
age_summary_chik <- chik %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_years), age_years >= 0, age_years <= 120) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cases = n(),
    q25 = quantile(age_years, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(age_years, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(age_years, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Share of deaths inside vs outside the currently licensed 18-59 age window.
# The formal eligibility analysis, including regional and wave stratification,
# is performed in 10_step1_eligibility_split.Rmd.
death_age_window_check <- chik %>%
  filter(is_death, !is.na(age_years)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_window = case_when(
      age_years < 18 ~ "<18",
      age_years < 60 ~ "18-59",
      TRUE ~ "60+"
    ),
    age_window = factor(age_window, levels = c("<18", "18-59", "60+"))
  ) %>%
  count(age_window, name = "deaths") %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * deaths / sum(deaths))

print(age_summary_chik)
print(death_age_window_check)
```
